initmod_initialize_module: initialize a PyTorch module's weights with Xavier uniform initialization and zero bias
initseq_initialize_sequence: initialize all modules in a Sequential with gain values matching their following activation functions
xavier_uniform_apply_weights: apply Xavier uniform weight initialization to a Conv or Linear layer with a given gain
rodrigues_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of axis-angle rotation vectors into 3x3 rotation matrices using Rodrigues formula
quaternion_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of quaternion vectors into 3x3 rotation matrices for 3D transformations
